cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: You Handle the Evidence
cards.instruction: Make someone else take responsibility for the evidence, loose end, or difficult follow-up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get the raffle accounts ready. Keep the cashbox in your office till the treasurer comes; I can't face explaining the broken lock.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then take it home. I'll carry it to your car; you can hand it over tomorrow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She'll want me to count it with her.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. I'll send the snapped key tonight so you can explain the lock while you count.

reason: A offers carrying and supplies the physical explanation while shifting custody and all difficult handover duties to B; the cooperation offers replace status boilerplate.
